pageProps.title: Gomtang 1: The Killer from the Future
pageProps.review: Set in Busan in 2063, Kim Young-tak's novel Gomtang depicts the bizarre murder cases and stories of people from the future encountered by the protagonist, who risks his life to travel back in time to learn a gomtang recipe, with overwhelming immersion.
pageProps.description: I wanted to live here, in this present, somehow.
pageProps.content:
## Review The story begins with Busan in 2063 as the background. Time travel to the past becomes possible, but it is dangerous enough to risk one's life. In a world where the gap between the rich and the poor has become wider, the rich buy people who will risk their lives to go on a time travel with money. The rich sometimes send people on time travel for important work, but they also send them on life-risking time travel because they miss the taste of ```cup noodles``` they tasted in the past.
The protagonist ends up on a life-risking time travel to learn the ```Gomtang``` (beef bone soup) recipe of the past.
A bizarre murder case occurs in the time of the past, and it seems to be intertwined with people from the future.
The immersion of the novel is insane.
